fields.System.Title: INV-403 — Mark stock damaged
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse operator, I want to mark stock as damaged where I find it, so that it
stops being allocated before someone tries to ship it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given available stock, when I mark a quantity damaged, then that quantity changes
  • status and leaves availability.
  • - Given the change, then a reason code is mandatory.
  • - Given damaged stock, then it can still be counted and can still be adjusted or
  • scrapped.
  • - Given damaged stock, then it is never allocated.
  • - Given the change, then a movement is written recording who found it and where.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Damaged stock remaining allocatable ([doc 05 WF 1](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
